The '''Galactic Frontier''' was the term given to the vastness of space beyond the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The name was in use around the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].
